universalEditor.title: Universal Editor
universalEditor.description: Visually edit your site content inline, directly on the rendered page.
universalEditor.noSelectionDescription: Click on an element in the page to select it and edit its properties.
universalEditor.noSitesDescription: Create a site first in the Content section, then come back here to edit it visually.
universalEditor.urlHint: Open any page instrumented with data-sh-* attributes for visual editing.
universalEditor.noWriteToken: No WRITE-scope API token found. Create one in Admin → API Tokens to enable saving.
universalEditor.siteNotFound: No site resolved for '{{key}}'. Pick one from the list.
universalEditor.bridgeAbsent: This page did not hand back the editor bridge.
universalEditor.bridgeAbsentHint: You can still see it, but nothing on it is editable. Either the page failed to load, or its front end does not support inline editing yet.
